name: Camp Discovery Teen Assistant Program
what_you_do: Help run hands-on STEAM camp activities for kindergarten to 7th grade campers. Earn over 80 community service hours.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer role. Earns over 80 community service hours.
duration: Camp breaks: fall, winter, spring and summer (Washoe County School District breaks)
deadline_text: No deadline or program dates listed.
how_to_apply: Use the Teen Assistant Application button on the page (online form). Then a 15-minute Zoom interview and an in-person training. Contact Kristen Kellogg, 775-398-5920, kkellogg@nvdm.org.
notes: You must be free during Washoe County School District breaks.
